from worker import execute

def test_api_valid_modes():
    # Mock enqueue
    def mock_enqueue(payload):
        return payload
    
    api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="all")
    api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="remote")
    api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="hybrid")
    api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="office")

def test_api_invalid_mode():
    def mock_enqueue(payload):
        pass
    try:
        api.submit("user1", mock_enqueue, mode="invalid")
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

def test_worker_filtering():
    # task mode "all"
    task_all = {"owner": "user1", "mode": "all"}
    jobs = [
        {"owner": "u2", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "u3", "mode": "hybrid"},
        {"owner": "u4", "mode": None},
        {"owner": "u5", "mode": "office"},
        {"owner": "u6"} # missing mode
    ]
    # If task mode is "all", all jobs should stay
    assert execute(task_all, jobs) == jobs

    # task mode "remote"
    task_remote = {"owner": "user1", "mode": "remote"}
    # Jobs with "remote", None, or missing should stay
    # Jobs with "hybrid" or "office" should be excluded
    expected_remote = [
        {"owner": "u2", "mode": "remote"},
        {"owner": "u4", "mode": None},
        {"owner": "u6"} # missing mode
    ]
    assert execute(task_remote, jobs) == expected_remote

    # task mode "office"
    task_office = {"owner": "user1", "mode": "office"}
    expected_office = [
        {"owner": "u5", "mode": "office"},
        {"owner": "u4", "mode": None},
        {"owner": "u6"} # missing mode
    ]
    assert execute(task_office, jobs) == expected_office

    # task mode missing (default to all)
    task_none = {"owner": "user1"}
    assert execute(task_none, jobs) == jobs

def test_worker_no_task_mode():
    # "Worker defaults missing legacy mode to all."
    # If task.get("mode") is None, it becomes "all".
    task_no_mode = {"owner": "user1"}
    jobs = [{"owner": "u2", "mode": "remote"}]
    assert execute(task_no_mode, jobs) == jobs

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_api_valid_modes()
    test_api_invalid_mode()
    test_worker_filtering()
    test_worker_no_task_mode()
    print("All tests passed!")
